macro.name: Thunder-Head Interceptor
macro.author: Zl1BOUaPLwDEujaL

description.value:
The Thunder-Head Interceptor

Wondrous Item, Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

This broom looks less like a cleaning tool and more like a rocket-propelled chassis. The handle is crafted from cold-forged dragon-bone, reinforced with brass valves, while the bristles consist of shimmering metallic wires that crackle with blue electricity and emit a faint smell of ozone.

  • Flying Speed: 80 ft. (Reduced to 60 ft. if carrying over 200 lbs).
  • Hype-Man (Quirk): The broom possesses a boisterous sentience (INT 10, WIS 12, CHA 16). While it cannot speak, it communicates via sound: stadium air-horn blasts on critical hits, rhythmic thumping like a war drum during initiative, and a sympathetic “OOH!” whenever you take damage.

Passive Features

  • Aero-Stabiliser: The broom locks into a perfect hover. You have Advantage on firearm attack rolls if you are at least 60 feet above your target (by elevation). Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus to AC against ranged attacks and the Evasion trait while mounted.
  • Kinetic Battery: The broom absorbs the shock of its own instability. Every time you take damage from Backfire, the broom stores 1 charge (maximum 3). When you hit a creature with a firearm attack, all stored charges are automatically expended to deal an extra 1d12 Force damage per charge.

Active Features

  • Full-Auto Overdrive (1/Day): As a bonus action, you push the broom to its limit. For 1 minute, you gain the benefits of Haste. When this effect ends, the broom “stalls”—its speed becomes 0 and its magic goes dormant until you spend a Bonus Action to Kickstart it.
  • The “Big Bang” Recoil (Reaction): When you hit a creature with a firearm attack, you can trigger a directional explosion. You instantly fly up to 30 feet in any direction without provoking opportunity attacks. The target and every creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or take 3d8 Thunder damage and be knocked Prone.

Defects

  • Kickstart Needed: To activate the broom’s flight each day (or after a stall), you must spend a Bonus Action revving the bristles. This creates a deafening mechanical roar audible up to 300 feet.
  • Backfire: Whenever you use Big Bang Recoil, you must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or take 1d6 Force damage from intense whiplash. Taking this damage stores a Kinetic Battery charge.
  • Fuel Guzzler: The broom requires 10 gp worth of “High-Octane Arcane Oil” every 24 hours. If not fueled, speed drops to 30 ft and it loses all Active Features and Aero-Stabiliser benefits.

Automation Notes

  • Aero-Stabiliser: +2 AC vs ranged is applied as -2 to incoming ranged attack rolls. Elevation advantage checks attacker vs target elevation difference ≥ 60 ft. Evasion applies to Dex saves (Evasion/superSaver).
  • Kinetic Battery: Charges stored in flags.midi-qol.thunderHeadCharges. Auto-expended on firearm hits via DamageBonusMacro.
  • Firearms: Detected by base weapon type: revolver, musket, pistol.
  • Fuel Guzzler & 200 lb weight limit: Not automated — track manually.
